name: firebase_analytics
summary: FlutterFire plugin for Google Analytics for Firebase, providing app-usage and engagement measurement.
advantages: Supports common product analytics and event-measurement workflows
tradeoffs: Requires an analytics event taxonomy and privacy or consent design
Platform support and measurement behavior should be checked against target platforms
recommendedFor: Product teams that need app usage and engagement analytics
